name: cardapio-digital
description: Cardápio digital para distribuidora de bebidas com backend Node.js + Express

scripts.health: node -e "const http=require('http'); const url='http://localhost:3001/api/health'; http.get(url, (res) => { let data=''; res.on('data', (chunk) => data += chunk); res.on('end', () => { try { const body = JSON.parse(data || '{}'); console.log(JSON.stringify({ status: res.statusCode, body }, null, 2)); process.exit(res.statusCode === 200 && body.ok ? 0 : 1); } catch (err) { console.error(err); process.exit(1); } }); }).on('error', (err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });"
